SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-15-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-15-2023 BY VISITING JUDGE SYLVIA L. HUSING. PLAINTIFF JULIANA GUTHNER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHRISTOPHER MEAS IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE IS 5 DAYS UNTIMELY. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE ISSUE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: SYLIVA L. HUSING; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-15-2023 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GUTHNER, JULIANA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MEAS, CHRISTOPHER THIS ACCIDENT WAS - "AN ACCIDENT." NEITHER PARTY IS AT FAULT. BIKE RIDER WAS IN THE AUTOMOBILE'S "BLIND SPOT" AS HER VEHICLE MOVED TO THE RIGHT ACROSS THE BIKE LANE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
